999008199.text:
みんな、いい調子よ。
そのまま速度を落とさず続けて！

localizations.en: Everyone's doing great. Keep up the pace!

999008199.text:
こ、これ、運動後の柔軟とは、わけが違うって……！
ぐぅ……ぐるじい……

localizations.en: T-this is nothing like stretching after exercise...! Ugh... I'm dying here...

999008199.text:
アルビーナ、もう音を上げるの？
あなたの覚悟はそんなものなの？　違うでしょう！

localizations.en: Alvina, are you giving up already? Is that really all you've got? I don't think so!

999008199.text:
もっと熱くなるのよ、アルビーナ！！
あなたの覚悟を見せてちょうだい！！

localizations.en: Come on, dig deeper!! Show me what you're made of!!

999008199.text: 姉様ならできるわ！
くぅ～……っ！！　やったるわーい！！
うぅ……も、もう無理かも……

localizations.en: Ugh... I-I don't think I can take much more...

999008199.text:
レスナちゃん、初めてなのに頑張っているわね。
もちろん無理はしちゃダメだけど……

localizations.en: You're doing wonderfully for your first time, Resna. Just don't push yourself too hard...

999008199.text:
この鍛錬は腕の筋肉が鍛えられるから、
錬金釜をかき混ぜる力も育つはずよ

localizations.en: This exercise works your arm muscles, so it'll actually help you stir the cauldron better too.

999008199.text:
錬金術に活きるんですね……！！
ま、まだまだ、頑張ります……っ！！

localizations.en: It carries over into alchemy...!! I-I can keep going...!!

999008199.text:
さっすがレスナちゃん！
アタシも騎士として、負けられない！

localizations.en: That's our Resna! And I can't fall behind as a knight!

999008199.text:
ヤンネさん！？
アタシとレスナでなんか扱い違くない！？

localizations.en: Janne?! Are you seriously giving me and Resna completely different treatment?!

999008199.text: こらアルビーナ、止まってるわよ！
うわーん！

さ、これが終わったら次は走り込みよ。
その後は少しの休憩を挟んで――

localizations.en: Alright, once we finish this it's time for a run. Then a short break, and after that—

999008199.text: ちょ、どんだけやらせる気なの……！？

localizations.en: W-wait, how much are you planning to put us through...?!

999008199.text:
今日はここまでにしましょうか。
みんな、お疲れさま

localizations.en: That's enough for today. Good work, everyone.

999008199.text: お疲れさまでした
お、お疲れさまでしたぁ……

ふふ、いい鍛錬になったわね。
いつもと違う環境でやりがいがあったわ

localizations.en: Hehe, that was a great session. It felt really rewarding in a new environment like this.

999008199.text:
明日もみんなでやりましょっか。
遊びに行く前に

localizations.en: Let's all do it again tomorrow. Before we head out for the day.

999008199.text: げっ！　明日も！？

ええ。明日も明後日も。
ケガしないように、準備運動を兼ねてね

localizations.en: That's right. Tomorrow and the day after. Think of it as a warmup—so no one gets hurt while we're having fun.

999008199.text:
あら、あそこにいる子、困ってるみたい。
ちょっと見てくるわ

localizations.en: Oh, that child over there looks like they're in trouble. Let me just go check on them.

999008199.text:
……こんな鍛錬、毎日続けられたら、
疲れちゃって遊ぶどころじゃないよ！！

localizations.en: ...If she keeps this up every single day, we'll be too worn out to enjoy anything!!

999008199.text:
やっほー二人とも。ヤドヴィガ見かけてない？
……って、なんかあった？

localizations.en: Hey you two. Have you seen Jadwiga? ...Wait, what happened to you?

999008199.text: なんだかすっごく疲れてる……？
あー、うん。実は――

localizations.en: Ahh, yeah. Well, the thing is—

999008199.text:
ってことで、ヤンネさんの鍛錬を止めないと
アタシたちの楽しい休暇が存続の危機に！

localizations.en: —so basically, if we don't do something about Janne's training sessions, our whole vacation is going to go up in smoke!

999008199.text:
うーんと……それなら何か理由を付けて
鍛錬に参加しなければいいんじゃないかな……？

localizations.en: Hmm... couldn't you just come up with some kind of excuse and not participate in the training...?

999008199.text:
うーん、そうなんだけど～、
アタシはヤンネさんとも一緒に遊びたいの！

localizations.en: I mean, sure, but... I actually want to spend time with Janne too!

999008199.text:
ええ。こういう休暇は初めてだって言ってたから、
みんなでいい思い出にしたい

localizations.en: Right. She said this kind of vacation is new to her. I want us all to make good memories together.

999008199.text:
もちろん、毎日の鍛錬が大切なのも分かるけどさ。
せっかくの水着と行楽地、楽しんでほしいじゃん……！

localizations.en: And of course daily training is important, I get that. But we've got swimsuits and a whole resort to enjoy—I want her to have fun too...!

999008199.text:
……それなら、鍛錬よりもやりたくなるような、
すっごく楽しい何かを用意してみるとかは？

localizations.en: ...Then what if you set up something so exciting that she'd rather do that than train?

999008199.text: たとえば？
それは、分からないけど――

すっごく楽しそうなことがあれば、
鍛錬なんてそっちのけよ！　多分！

localizations.en: —but if there's something fun enough, training will be the last thing on her mind! Probably!
